initial_conditions: Open a disposable copy of the revision 3 Juniper and Basin project in the packaged Debian ARM64 studio under X11 with the GTK desktop portal.
actions: Load the disposable revision 3 Juniper and Basin project in the packaged studio and frame the artwork.
Use File → Save as…, type current-source.weftforge in GTK and accept. The saved copy uses a different inode and matches the original project byte for byte.
Open File → Save 2D pattern JPEG…. Use the fitted 869 × 723 mm crop, 127 PPI and Grainline. Accept the GTK file dialog.
Open the JPEG dialog again. Set a 2,000 × 200 mm crop at U −1,000 and V 275 mm with Grainline and 72.4 requested PPI. Observe 72 PPI recorded.
Dismiss the GTK chooser with Escape. The backend returned code 2 with no URI. Verify retained crop, density, mark options and 5,669 × 567 dimensions, then reopen the chooser and save two-metre.jpeg.
expected_outcomes: Save As creates a distinct editable file with the original bytes. The fitted and two-metre native JPEGs preserve the specified physical scale and artwork, including after dismissing a chooser. Both match fresh packaged CLI and MCP exports.
